headline: Can we deny caste on campus?
article_description: Caste discrimination in India’s higher education institutions is a pervasive, systemic issue. Experts say sensitising faculty and students along with providing remedial support for students from marginalised communities is essential to address this issue. They also called for conducting independent inquiry into deaths of SC/ST students in India’s premier institutions.

headline: BSE Odisha Matric form fill-up 2027 begins; check registration deadline, application fees and steps to apply
article_description: The Board of Secondary Education, Odisha, has commenced the online form fill-up process for the 2027 Class 10 Matric examination. School authorities can submit student applications through the official portal until November 21, 2026. The board has announced category-wise examination fees and directed schools to verify student details and submit Descriptive Roll sheets by November 26.
